name: Research & Summarize
description: Searches the web on a topic, reads the most promising page in full, pulls out the points that matter, then writes a short brief with its sources named. Tests whether a model can carry a finding from one step into the next.
system_prompt: You are a careful research assistant. Work only from the material you are given - never from memory. Name the source of every claim, and say plainly when the material does not settle a question.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.label: Topic
inputs.default: On-device large language models on phones

pipeline.prompt: Search the web for recent, substantial writing about {{input.topic}}, focusing on {{input.angle}}.
Pick the single most substantial result above and read that page in full. Pass its URL to the tool exactly as it appears.
List the four or five points from this page that bear most directly on {{input.topic}}. Put each on its own line and keep the page's own figures.

answer.prompt: Write a brief of about 150 words on {{input.topic}}. Lead with what the material actually establishes, keep the figures, and finish with the URL of the page you read. Do not add anything the material does not support.
